title: Origin story: Rumpelstiltskin
description: Rumpelstiltskin is the imp of the Grimm tale who spun straw into gold for the miller's daughter — for her necklace, her ring, and finally her firstborn. She could keep the child only by guessing his name, which she learned when his own gloating song betrayed it.

description: Ranked abilities: Gloating — rank 100/100; Spinning magic — rank 98/100; Bargaining — rank 97/100; Rage — rank 96/100; Stealth — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Rumpelstiltskin
description: Powers: Straw-to-gold transmutation; The bargain's binding force; A name as his only vulnerability.

title: Stamina feats: Rumpelstiltskin
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Spun all night, three nights; Raged himself apart when named.

title: Crossover notes: Rumpelstiltskin
description: Rumpelstiltskin crosses naturally with: bargains, names, the price of help.
